## Objective
- Increase the playable RTS map by another 10× and make buildings 10× bigger.

## Requirements
- Preserve playable controls and camera behavior.
- Run the game, capture a JPEG no wider than 1280px, and inspect only the latest screenshot.

## Decisions
- Scale `MAP_ENLARGEMENT`, `WORLD_SIZE`, and building sizes by 10×; increase the camera far plane to accommodate the larger world.
- Keep `MAP_SCALE` unchanged by changing its divisor from `160` to `1600`, preserving coordinate-to-screen behavior.

- Updated map and building scale constants in `game.js` and `renderer3d.js`.
